# Sweep TV 1.3.0-sweep.151

- Horizontal title rows form a seamless circular reel: the first title is already visible after the last, and movement continues in the same direction without an empty tail or reset. A bounded set of card views reuses the existing artwork cache.

- Finish setup offers separate Formula 1 and Cricket switches. Both start off with no saved preference, and saved choices carry over.

- Continue Watching combines progress from supported streaming apps and preserves recent resume entries across restarts.

- Home title rows scroll in both directions. Visible artwork loads first and title updates retain focus.

- The Sweep Recommendation Engine can load its hosted catalogue in supported regions without a personal TMDB key. Picks depend on your apps, language settings, and regional availability.

- Title cards show provider badges and IMDb scores where available. Title links depend on the provider and supplied metadata.

- Choose dock apps, home themes, and top bar widgets in Sweep TV settings. Home and remote controls vary with device support.

- Sports Center shows Formula 1 schedules, results, and standings, plus cricket scores and fixtures. Saved cricket scores are marked Cached.
